_format.what: One entry per agent. model null = the procedural placeholder is shown, tagged PLACEHOLDER CHARACTER. A licensed model is used only when every required field is present and both files exist in this directory.

required.model: file name of a glTF 2.0 binary (.glb) in this directory: one skinned humanoid (Mixamo or VRM/humanoid bone names, or map them in 'bones'), ARKit 52 face blendshapes (or map them in 'blendshapes'); Meshopt compression allowed; textures PNG/JPEG/WebP inside the .glb (KTX2 is not supported in this build)
required.license_file: file name, in this directory, of the licence text shipped with the model
required.license_spdx: the licence identifier (SPDX, or LicenseRef-<vendor> for a commercial licence)
required.licensed_from: who granted the licence (vendor, artist, or contract reference)
required.test_asset: must be false: a test asset is never shown as a character

optional.yaw: radians to turn the model to face the camera
optional.bones: role -> exact bone name, for rigs outside the built-in Mixamo/VRM table
optional.blendshapes: ARKit name -> exact morph target name, for faces outside the ARKit naming
